description: Test whether pathogenic TWIST1 missense variants cluster in the bHLH domain relative to non-pathogenic missense variants
code:
import requests, json, time, re
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

base="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"; H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
ids=requests.get(base+"esearch.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","term":"TWIST1[gene]","retmax":3000,"retmode":"json"},headers=H,timeout=60).json()["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
recs=[]
for i in range(0,len(ids),300):
    d=requests.get(base+"esummary.fcgi",params={"db":"clinvar","retmode":"json","id":",".join(ids[i:i+300])},headers=H,timeout=90).json()
    recs += [v for k,v in d.get("result",{}).items() if k!="uids"]; time.sleep(0.4)
aa3=set('Ala Arg Asn Asp Cys Gln Glu Gly His Ile Leu Lys Met Phe Pro Ser Thr Trp Tyr Val Ter'.split())
rows=[]
for v in recs:
    g=v.get("germline_classification",{}); cls=g.get("description","")
    t=v.get("title",""); vtype=(v.get("variation_set") or [{}])[0].get("variant_type","")
    m=re.search(r"\(p\.([A-Za-z]{3})(\d+)([A-Za-z]{3}|fs|=)?",t)
    pos=int(m.group(2)) if m else np.nan
    if "fs" in t: cons="frameshift"
    elif "Ter)" in t: cons="nonsense"
    elif m and m.group(3)=="=": cons="synonymous"
    elif m and m.group(3) in aa3: cons="missense"
    else: cons="other"
    rows.append(dict(cls=cls,pos=pos,cons=cons,title=t,
                     traits="; ".join(sorted({x.get("trait_name","") for x in g.get("trait_set",[])}))))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df["PLP"]=df.cls.str.contains("athogenic",na=False)&~df.cls.str.contains("Conflicting",na=False)
df["BLB"]=df.cls.str.contains("enign",na=False)&~df.cls.str.contains("Conflicting",na=False)

# UniProt Q15672 domain boundaries
BHLH=(108,160); BASIC=(108,120); H1=(121,133); LOOP=(134,147); H2=(148,160); TBOX=(183,192); L=202
mis=df[(df.cons=="missense")&df.pos.notna()].copy()
mis["in_bhlh"]=mis.pos.between(*BHLH)
plp=mis[mis.PLP]; nonplp=mis[~mis.PLP]
tab=[[int(plp.in_bhlh.sum()), int((~plp.in_bhlh).sum())],
     [int(nonplp.in_bhlh.sum()), int((~nonplp.in_bhlh).sum())]]
OR,p=fisher_exact(tab)
print("Missense variants: P/LP n=%d, VUS/benign n=%d"%(len(plp),len(nonplp)))
print("2x2 [in bHLH, outside] P/LP vs non-P/LP:",tab)
print("Fisher exact OR=%.2f, p=%.3g"%(OR,p))
print("P/LP missense in bHLH: %.0f%%  |  non-P/LP missense in bHLH: %.0f%%"%(100*plp.in_bhlh.mean(),100*nonplp.in_bhlh.mean()))
# bHLH is 53/202 = 26.2% of protein
from scipy.stats import binomtest
bt=binomtest(int(plp.in_bhlh.sum()), len(plp), (BHLH[1]-BHLH[0]+1)/L, alternative="greater")
print("Binomial vs 26.2%% of protein length: p=%.3g"%bt.pvalue)
print("\nTruncating (nonsense/frameshift) P/LP positions: median=%.0f, range %d-%d, n=%d"%(
    df[(df.PLP)&(df.cons.isin(["nonsense","frameshift"]))&df.pos.notna()].pos.median(),
    df[(df.PLP)&(df.cons.isin(["nonsense","frameshift"]))&df.pos.notna()].pos.min(),
    df[(df.PLP)&(df.cons.isin(["nonsense","frameshift"]))&df.pos.notna()].pos.max(),
    df[(df.PLP)&(df.cons.isin(["nonsense","frameshift"]))&df.pos.notna()].shape[0]))
print("\nSweeney-Cox records:"); print(df[df.traits.str.contains("Sweeney",na=False)][["title","cls"]].to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(11,6.5),sharex=True,gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[1,1]})
for ax,sub,color,lab in [(axes[0],df[(df.PLP)&df.pos.notna()],"#c0392b","Pathogenic / likely pathogenic"),
                         (axes[1],df[(~df.PLP)&df.pos.notna()],"#2c7fb8","VUS, benign, likely benign, conflicting")]:
    for lo,hi,c,name in [(*BASIC,"#f4d03f","basic"),(*H1,"#7fc97f","helix 1"),(*LOOP,"#d9d9d9","loop"),(*H2,"#7fc97f","helix 2"),(*TBOX,"#bc80bd","Twist box")]:
        ax.axvspan(lo,hi,color=c,alpha=.55,zorder=0)
    counts=sub.groupby("pos").size()
    ax.bar(counts.index,counts.values,color=color,width=1.4)
    ax.set_xlim(0,L); ax.set_ylabel("variants"); ax.set_title(lab,loc="left",fontsize=10)
for lo,hi,name in [(*BASIC,"basic"),(*H1,"helix 1"),(*LOOP,"loop"),(*H2,"helix 2"),(*TBOX,"Twist box")]:
    axes[1].annotate(name,((lo+hi)/2,-0.22),xycoords=("data","axes fraction"),ha="center",fontsize=8)
axes[1].set_xlabel("TWIST1 protein position (UniProt Q15672, 202 aa)")
fig.suptitle("ClinVar TWIST1 variants cluster in the bHLH domain when pathogenic",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
